query:
mutation ($input: UpdateCartLineItemInput!) { cart { updateCartLineItem(input: $input) { cart {
      version lineItems { totalQuantity physicalItems { quantity } } } } } }
note: A conditional write refused. The cart was created at version 1, raised to version 2 by an unconditional write, and this asserts version 1 against it — the stale-tab case in ROB-2558. The write is not applied: a read afterwards still showed quantity 4, and the same mutation with version 2 succeeded. `version` is the only way to provoke this, so the prefix means one thing.
